description: CSV pivot table / group-by — Group and pivot CSV data like a spreadsheet pivot table, offline. Pass csv= (header row; comma, tab, semicolon or pipe auto-detected), rows= group-by column(s), optional cols= pivot column, values= numeric column(s) and agg= sum|avg|count|min|max|median|distinct|stdev|first|last. Handles $1,200.50, 12% and (30) negatives; returns table rows, grand total, pivot values, CSV output and notes on skipped non-numeric cells. Optional sort=key|value|asc, limit= (max 5000). Up to 50,000 rows. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_pivot
